facts.statement: The annual Festival of Hearts has returned to Vegalegre, celebrating a old love story between the Pixies Rois and Araiana.
facts.quote: El festival anual de Corazones ha regresado a Vegalegre.

facts.statement: The festival's central symbol is a special flower planted by Rois and Araiana; it still blooms and is red, pink and magenta, standing out among the sunflowers in Vegalegre.
facts.quote: Se destaca del resto de los girasoles en Vegalegre por sus colores rojo, rosa y magenta.

facts.statement: The festival offers daily quests, members-only quests, Station Cash items, coin shop items, and new outfits that were to arrive the following week.
facts.quote: Hay misiones diarias, misiones exclusivamente para miembros, al igual que artículos de Station Cash y artículos en la tienda de monedas

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (El Festival anual de Corazones ha Regresado)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language Free Realms news post saying the annual Festival of Hearts has returned to Vegalegre. It describes the festival's legend, its events and rewards, and the villain Stone Heart, who appears when the festival flower blooms. The post gives only a relative date ('4 months, 1 day ago'), so no exact date can be set.
